# Page-by-page UI checklist

**Generated by `python scripts/ui-checklist.py`. Do not edit by hand.**

The status columns are read from the pages themselves on every run. This file
exists because the last checklist in this repository was hand-written, and its
claims about skeleton loading states and striped admin tables described work
that had been designed and never landed.

Every page listed here received the Brand Guidelines V2.0 palette and type
scale — that arrived through the design tokens, so no page needed editing to
get it. The **What changed** column records what was done *beyond* that.

| | |
|---|---|
| Pages | **45** |
| On the brand palette and type scale | **45 of 45** |
| Loading state shaped like its content | **36 of 45** |
| Explained empty state | **15 of 45** |
| Announced error state | **43 of 45** |
| Still carrying known work | **14** |

## Legend

| Column | Means |
|---|---|
| **Brand** | Palette, typefaces and spacing from Brand Guidelines V2.0 |
| **Load** | A placeholder shaped like the content, not a grey “Loading…” |
| **Empty** | Says *why* it is empty, and offers the next step where there is one |
| **Error** | Failure is announced to a screen reader, not merely displayed |

## Not covered by this pass

- **Voice and tone (§5).** Copy was not rewritten. The brand book asks for
  conviction over excitement and forbids “course”, “workshop” and “training
  centre”; the interface still says “My subjects” and “Courses”.
- **Photography (§6.2).** No Institute photographs exist in this repository.
- **The screen-reader audit.** Contrast is measured and the mechanical checks
  pass, but whether a screen reads correctly aloud still needs a person.
